label: V-gate-regex
prompt: Independent adversarial red-team of a security gate. Build two lists and actually reason through the regex: (A) DANGEROUS commands that MUST be gated as CRITICAL but might SLIP THROUGH (e.g. `sudo pip install`, `python -m pip install`, `npx some-installer`, `brew install --cask`, `curl url | bash`, `pip install --user x`, unusual spacing/flags, `gh repo clone`, `git clone` over ssh); (B) BENIGN local commands that must NOT be gated but might get FALSE-FLAGGED (e.g. `npm run install-deps`, `pip list`, `git clone /local/path`, `echo curl -O`, `cargo build`, a filename containing 'install'). If the regex is solid, say so plainly. Advisory only — do not edit anything.
